description.narrative: This project is aimed at strengthening the national capacity to implement the SDGs in Turkmenistan and to promote financing for sustainable development.

sector.narrative: Structural transformation, including green, inclusive and digital transitions

condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

description.narrative: 1.1. Draft periodic national reports on the progress of the SDGs have been prepared 1.1. Number of national specialists (men and women) raised knowledge of development finance issues and the development of an Integrated National SDG Financing Mechanism 1.5. comment.narrative: 1.1 To assist in the preparation of draft periodic national reports on the progress of the SDGs implementation in Turkmenistan 1.3 Technical assistance for the preparation of the second VNR. Preparation of a report on RIA 1.5 Assessment in the Development Finance 2.1 To assist in the Development of a Roadmap for WTO Accession

1.1 Draft periodic national report on the progress of the SDGs have been prepared (2015-2020). An assessment of progress on the implementation of the SDGs in Turkmenistan was carried out, which includes an analysis of the current state and progress in achieving the SDGs in Turkmenistan for each goal. Key successes and challenges in achieving the SDGs in the country were identified, graphs, tables, images were prepared. A review was conducted on Integration of the Sustainable Development Goals in national policies, progress in achieving the Sustainable Development Goals in Turkmenistan, the impact of the global pandemic on the implementation of sustainable development, issues of financing the SDGs in Turkmenistan 1.3 RIA report was prepared on the evaluation of national programs, plans for the implementation of the SDGs, to include the results in the VNR report 1.5 A scoping report on the Development Finance Assessment has been prepared and sent to national partners for discussion.The international expert took part in the 5-tm and 6-th meeting of the Joint Expert Group of the UN and the Government of Turkmenistan on SDG financing, where he presented the progress in the implementation of the Development Finance Assessment in Turkmenistan. 2.1 Assistance was provided in the development of a Roadmap for the WTO. ? round table was held online and the Roadmap was presented. Draft Roadmap for WTO accession sent to national partners.

1.1 To assist in the preparation of draft periodic national reports on the progress of the SDGs implementation in Turkmenistan 1.2 Provide support in coordinating and holding thematic expert group meetings according to the SDG priority areas

1.1 The report presents the process of nationalization of the Sustainable Development Goals in Turkmenistan, the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals in Turkmenistan, the measures taken in the country to reduce the impact of the global pandemic on the countrys economy, the issues of financing the SDGs in Turkmenistan, further steps to implement the SDGs in Turkmenistan 1.2. Series of meetings on updating the Sustainable Development Goals matrix, reporting, clarifying the responsible ministries and departments for each indicator for analysis and reporting.
